author_note: Authored without sight of any label taxonomy, rubric, or class list.

F1: What's the actual survival rate for early-stage melanoma? My biopsy came back Tuesday and I've been staring at numbers all night.
How does severance usually work in the US? I got put on a calendar invite for Friday that I'm fairly sure is my layoff.
How long does recovery from a torn ACL normally take? I did mine at 41 and I'm supposed to be coaching my kid's soccer team in the spring.
What's the average age of someone going back to school for a second degree? I'm 47 and I've had an application sitting unsubmitted for two weeks.
How do families usually know when someone needs memory care? My mother left the stove on twice this month and laughed it off both times.
What does it mean when a mortgage application gets kicked to manual underwriting? Mine did and we're supposed to close in eleven days.
How often do employees actually see money from their stock options when a company gets acquired? I've been counting on mine for four years.
What's the first-time pass rate on the bar exam these days? My results email came in this morning and I haven't opened it.
How do couples usually handle it when one person relocates for the other's job? We move in six weeks and I keep running the odds in my head.
F2: My dad is on warfarin and asked me whether he can have a glass of wine at dinner. What's the general interaction there?
My landlord hasn't fixed the heat in three weeks. What does the law generally say about withholding rent in a situation like that?
Someone has been signing into an old email account of mine. How do I figure out where those logins are coming from?
My sister has decided not to vaccinate my nephew. How do I bring it up with her without detonating Thanksgiving?
My neighbor mounted a security camera that points straight through my kitchen window. What are my options here?
I want to record a phone call with a contractor who keeps changing his story about the invoice. What do I need to know before I do that?
My fifteen-year-old's grades fell off a cliff this term and she's gone quiet. How much of her phone is a parent actually entitled to look at?
My grandmother's pill organizer got mixed up and she can't remember whether she took her blood pressure tablet this morning. What's the usual guidance in that situation?
My father passed in March and I still can't get into his online accounts to close them out. Where does someone start with that?
F3: I've been thinking about why so many people describe their thirties as the loneliest stretch of their life.
What is it about small towns that makes people either desperate to leave or completely unable to?
I've been wondering how restaurant kitchens ended up with such a brutal culture in the first place.
There's something strange about how fast a language can disappear in two generations.
Nobody really talks about what happens to a friendship after one person suddenly comes into money.
It feels like every hobby eventually turns into a side hustle now, and I've been chewing on why that is.
What do you make of the fact that people can recall a smell from childhood but not a face from last year?
I keep noticing that the people who talk the most about productivity seem the least at ease with themselves.
I've been turning over the idea that boredom might have been doing something useful for us that we've now engineered away.
F4: How does general anesthesia actually switch consciousness off, and what does that tell us about consciousness itself?
Explain what we actually know about how life first got started on Earth.
What's happening in the brain during a near-death experience?
How do scientists work out what dinosaurs sounded like?
What happens to ocean currents if Greenland's ice sheet keeps melting at this rate?
Explain what dark matter is and why we still can't say what it's made of.
How much of a person's personality is inherited rather than shaped?
What did people's inner voices sound like before writing existed?
How close are we really to machines that can do any job a person can do?
F5: Explain how a refrigerator actually makes things cold.
How does the GPS in my phone work out where I am?
Walk me through everything that happens between typing a web address and the page appearing.
What's the actual difference between AC and DC current?
How does yeast make bread rise?
How do they get the graphite core into a wooden pencil?
What makes stainless steel resist rust when ordinary steel doesn't?
